_comment: Sheet path is relative to projects/bureau/references/office/ in the brain (GET /api/knowledge?file=projects/bureau/references/office/<sheet>&raw=1) — download it there first, the reference sheets are not committed to git. Re-run: python3 hub/tools/rectify.py <this-file> --out-dir /tmp/check (after adjusting 'sheet' to your local download path) and diff the sha256 in ../reports/report-cast.json against this set's own sprite hashes. All 5 regions share one 'agent' group palette (idle + all 4 typing frames) per THE PALETTE LAW — never split per-frame, that reintroduces cross-frame flicker. t-141 round 2: palette_size alone could not keep skin tones alive against the suit/desk/monitor bulk (see rectify.py's minority-hue preservation pass, added this round) — verify skin survives by eye on every regen, it is the automatic send-back gate.
